title: Write Scope Binding
description: Runtime-authored binding of exactly one WriteScopeApproval to exactly one mutating execution attempt. Binding is created by Runtime before worker mutation authority is granted. Wave 3 does not consume the Approval; consumption is reserved for successful mutation completion (Wave 4). Single-use: an Approval cannot re-bind while it has an active or completed binding.

binding_id.description: Deterministic id: wsb- + sha256(approval_id + ':' + run_id + ':' + bound_at + ':' + target_id)[:24].

run_id.description: Execution attempt id (handoff id, session id, or plan-execute run id).

target_id.description: Repository identity from the frozen Approval body; must match the execution target.

runner_id.description: Selected runner/backend identity when known at bind time.

bound_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when Runtime created the binding.

status.description: Binding lifecycle. active reserves the Approval for this attempt; completed/failed mark terminal execution outcomes. Approval consumption is Wave 4.

body_hash.description: Copied from Approval at bind time after integrity re-check.

base_sha.description: Frozen base_sha from Approval; must equal git rev-parse HEAD in workspace_root at bind time.

workspace_root.description: Absolute path of the repository workspace used for base_sha and root resolution.

writable_roots.description: Absolute writable roots resolved from Approval allowed_roots against workspace_root. Path checks still apply denied_roots with deny-wins semantics.

denied_roots.description: Absolute denied roots resolved from Approval denied_roots at bind time. Empty when no denies. Deny wins on path-prefix overlap with writable_roots.

terminal_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when binding left active status.
